config.name: it5-r4-decision-config
config.standing: final-run config 2026-09-25: readthrough prior derived from R1's allele_dosage.tsv at run time; missense prior kept from H084 (no R-table measures the child's missense abundance); test performances are stated R4 assumptions, swept in the tornado
config.framing: triage heuristic over stated weights; not a calibrated posterior, not a probability of benefit, not advice for or against giving any drug to any patient
config.combine_source: R4 choice: a drug's utility is its best single argument; 'noisy_or' would reward convergence, which iteration 4 measured at chance level (entry 155, H094 refuted)

missense_class.source: the register's triage weight for H084 ('the missense is destabilising', supported 0.55): ThermoMPNN ddG at the 87th percentile of 19,950 BubR1 substitutions, buried, pLDDT >= 90 (docs/iteration4/step-9/methodology/149-the-stability-atlas-and-the-childs-missense.md). The same entry's calibration (AUROC 0.60, 95% CI 0.13-1.00, n = 8; H083 refuted) says the predictor cannot yet separate the classes, so this is a weight, not a probability. Kept at the final run: no R1-R3 table holds a measured abundance for this missense (R1 entry 158 states the child's BubR1 level has never been measured; R2 entry 159 measures drug effects in cancer lines, not the allele)

readthrough_feasible.source: derived at run time from R1's dosage arithmetic (entry 158, ressources/track2/it5/allele_dosage.tsv): 'feasible' = a readthrough scenario's gain lifts an untreated child scenario that sits below R1's segregation-fidelity threshold to at or above it. Strict reading (used): real-dose agents only ('readthrough only' rows). Lenient reading (tornado end): also R1's two stated upper bounds (complete NMD blockade, perfect agent). Equal weight per (start, gain) pair

applicability._doc: factor in [0, 1] that a row's mechanism branch acts in a world-state; a variable not listed for a branch does not affect it

safety.source: R4 choice. Order follows iteration 4's K2 rule (both sources flag = fail, one = caution; docs/iteration4/step-10/methodology/155-convergence-and-checks.md, method of entry 152); magnitudes are not measured. 'unassessed' (drug absent from the per-child table) is below 'unflagged' by design: no flag is not safety. 'caution' (0.5) and 'avoid' (0.0) come from the avoid list (R3 harm rows, same-disease exposures, do-not classes, R1's ruled-out-as-harmful rows); the lowest factor of a drug's classes applies

control.source: R4 choice. A route whose positive control failed is uninterpretable (docs/iteration5/notes/exploratory-no-hypotheses.md; the lesson of entry 153); 'penalty' keeps its rows visible at a quarter weight, 'exclude' drops them. 'n/a' rows (R1's published measurements and facts, not outputs of its context model) take na_factor 1.0: the route's own rubric already grades them (entry 158 section 4); swept 0.5-1.0

baseline.source: the reference action: every utility is relative to not acting on this list

tests.name: chx_chase_blot
tests.source: the experiment named in submissions/track2/iteration-4/report.md 7.3: a BubR1 Western blot with a cycloheximide chase (protein decay rate) in the child's cells against the parents'. Performance is an R4 assumption, swept 0.6-0.99 in the tornado. No R1-R3 table states this test's performance, so the value stays an assumption

tests.name: readthrough_reporter
tests.source: optional: a dual-luciferase read-through reporter carrying the child's stop codon and context. Performance is an R4 assumption. R1 states no reporter-to-protein agreement, so the value stays an assumption

config.aliases_source: R4 choice: a class row names its members; the named tool compound or the named class members take weight 1.0, members the row names only as clinic analogues take 0.4 (R3's 'class analogue approved' translation factor, entry 160). A member the row does not name is not added

meta.assumptions: state variables are independent; a row's mechanism branch acts only in the states its applicability rule names; utilities are products of stated weights; a drug absent from the safety table is 'unassessed', never 'safe'
meta.limitations: every weight is a choice or a placeholder (the config's todo markers list which); no harm term beyond the safety factor; EVSI assumes the test's sensitivity and specificity are known; utility units are not money, QALYs or probabilities
meta.validation: positive control: the hand-worked four-drug case in tests/test_drugs_decision.py is reproduced exactly (EU, EVPI 0.18, EVSI 0.096, flip at P(unstable) = 0.36)

sources.clinical: the proband's 7 own HPO terms enter only through the per-child safety table (iteration 4, entries 152/155: OnSIDES label effects matched to the terms)
sources.genomic: the two BUB1B alleles enter as state variables (stop_gained -> readthrough_feasible; missense -> missense_class) and, through the safety table, as PharmCAT actionability words; no position is read or written
